name: cx-goal-one-rule
task: Open the door and then pick up the box in the other room, and try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task commands two events, opening the door and picking up the target box, but the hard Existence(door_open) plus Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) only makes door_open required; nothing forces target_picked_up (the environment can park in a final state forever after opening the door). Add a hard Existence(target_picked_up); then Existence(door_open) is forced by the Precedence chain and should be removed as redundant. The soft Absence(key_lost) is correct: the ban is on key_lost itself, whose definition already includes 'before the door was opened', so no Precedence is needed.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) hard with Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) hard captures opening the door before picking up the box and forces door_open. 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed' matches soft Absence(key_lost), since key_lost is defined as the key dropped while the door is closed.
